objective: Measure how Film Grunge's deterministic hash-grain field changes between consecutive Composition frames, its temporal autocorrelation over short frame lags, block-size dependence, exact low-16-bit repeat period and deterministic random-access behavior.

scope.effect: ArtifactFilmGrungeEffect grain equation only: frameSeed, grainBlock and blockHash-to-grain mapping. grainAmount=.075, seed=1977; all other controls neutral.
scope.method: Independent NumPy float32 model of the source arithmetic over a 28x28 opaque tone chart for frames 0..4095. Coordinates are deliberately bounded so the source signed-int x/y hash products remain within int32 range; no undefined-overflow assumption is required for this fixture.
excluded: large product-resolution pixels where source signed-int hash multiplication can overflow
perceptual acceptance or film emulation claim

comparison.baseline: Per-pixel source tone chart at grainAmount=0; paired grain residual reference only, not an appearance target.
candidates: 4096 sequential Composition frame indices starting at 0
repeat/random-access frame indices 0,37,2048,4095 queried in a different order
comparison.ground_truth: The inspected source equation is the model reference; no approved temporal grain appearance or compiled pixel capture exists.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive equation result. Verify exact model determinism and key period algebra; report measured correlations/field changes without labeling them perceptually stable or unstable.

materials.fixture: Locally generated 28x28 opaque grayscale tone chart with three vertical bands (.10,.50,.90); grain residual is also analyzed directly so base tone addition does not substitute for residual statistics.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Record fixture, plan, source, runner, metrics and preview hashes.

conditions.integer_safety: Max x hash product is 27*73856093=1994114511 and max y product is 27*19349663=522440901, both within signed int32. No coordinate hash overflow is induced in this study.
conditions.frame_seed: frameSeed=uint32(uint64(seed)*1664525 + uint64(compositionFrame)*1013904223); seed=1977; frame=0..4095. Arithmetic stays within uint64 before narrowing.
conditions.grain_equation: grainBlock=positive std::round-equivalent grainSize; blockHash=frameSeed XOR uint32((x/grainBlock)*73856093) XOR uint32((y/grainBlock)*19349663); grain=(float(blockHash & 0xffff)/32767.5 - 1)*.075; output component c=source component c+grain*(c==2 ? 1.05 : c==0 ? .92 : 1.0); alpha remains opaque.
temporal_metrics: per-pixel residual lag correlation at lags 1,2,3,12,24,60,120,240,480,960,2048
frame mean/std/RMS and frame-to-frame residual RMSE
fraction of changed pixels and duplicate full fields
per-pixel complete low-16-bit value coverage over 65536-frame analytic cycle
per-channel grain scale and temporal correlation
exact repeatability of queried frame indices
spatial block constancy for each grainSize
conditions.display: Selected frames are enlarged with nearest-neighbor for a compact contact sheet; raw float32 residual metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify source markers, safe coordinate arithmetic, positive half-up grainBlock mapping, exact frameSeed/hash equation, frame-index determinism and gain-zero identity.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Repeated frame queries are bit-identical in the model; every adjacent frame changes each low-16-bit hash value; block-constancy matches grainBlock. No compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect selected sequential frames and fixed-tone bands; report whether spatial blocks and temporal residual changes are observable at the model display scale.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No perceptual accept/reject; 28x28 model and display enlargement are not product Viewer evidence.

color_and_alpha.reason: This study isolates temporal grain residuals on an opaque neutral tone chart; prior separate studies cover alpha association and channel mode.

temporal_stability.method: Analyze exact deterministic fields over fixed Composition frame indices and repeated seeks in the model.
temporal_stability.unverified: Actual compiled source output, runtime cadence, perceived shimmer/flicker and behavior under motion.

render_paths_and_resolution.reason: 28x28 is chosen to keep source signed-int coordinate products defined; it does not establish product-size behavior or render-path parity.

performance.reason: No product timing, allocation or memory measurement.

execution.backend: Python 3 and NumPy; offline equation model only.
execution.threshold_policy: Descriptive only; no temporal perceptual threshold is invented.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed chart, seed, frame range and grainSize values; record Python/NumPy and all source/plan/runner/output hashes.

amendments.reason: After the first model run, source review found that ArtifactFilmGrungeEffect multiplies the common raw grain field by a channel-specific factor (component 0=.92, component 1=1.0, component 2=1.05) before adding it to RGB.
amendments.change: Preserve the first scalar-field-only metrics as exploratory evidence; amend the source-equation model, displayed frames and metrics to apply the three component multipliers, and rerun the full frame/size comparison.
amendments.impact: Raw hash-field temporal correlations remain valid; final output/color metrics and previews now include the registered channel scale. No threshold or product acceptance criterion changes.
